title: Circular Gauge
text: Display signal value during simulation on circular gauge with customizable appearance, {Label} sets Position of label displaying name of connected element; {Connection} sets the signal to connect and display signal connection, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Tick Interval} sets the interval between major tick marks, {Direction}, {Lock Aspect Ratio} sets the option to maintain block aspect ratio, {Scale Colors} sets the color indications on gauge scale colors for scale, {Origin} sets the value on scale from which needle moves and value bar, {Arc}, {Start Angle} sets the angular location of scale minimum, {Inner Radius} sets the radius of free end of scale tick marks, {Outer Radius} sets the span line radius scalar, {X Offset} sets the horizontal offset of left edge of scale bounding box from left edge of block, {Y Offset} sets the vertical offset of top edge of scale bounding box from top edge of block, {Width} scales width scalar, {Height} scales height scalar, {Tick Color} sets the color of scale tick marks, span line, and block name, {Minor Tick Height} sets the height of minor tick marks on scale, {Label Color} scales label font color, {Label Radius} sets the distance of scale labels from scale center, {Rotate Image} sets the rotation of needle image, {Offset from Center} sets the offset of needle image center from scale, {Use Background Color} sets the option to specify solid block background, {Color} sets the block background color, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity and {Corner radius} sets the offset of outer edge of area with block background color from tick marks. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Signal to connect and display signal connection options

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum tick mark value 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum tick mark value 100 (default) | scalar
